name: Desert Modern
definition: Low horizontal furniture and sun-baked colors bring the calm of desert modernism into an urban home.
materials: sand linen; saddle leather; travertine; walnut; clay
living: sand low box sofa; saddle-leather sling chair; rectangular travertine coffee table; walnut slatted TV cabinet; compact rectangular walnut dining table with four saddle-leather chairs; clay dome pendant
bed: walnut platform queen; sand linen; rust woven throw; two walnut nightstands and clay table lamps; desert abstract art
solarium: teak sling lounge furniture with rust weatherproof pads; slatted teak dining set
implement: Let low silhouettes echo the long glazing; use terracotta in textiles and pots instead of replacing floors.
avoid: Avoid cacti as a theme or artificial desert architecture.

name: California Casual
definition: A relaxed, sunny mix of comfortable slipcovers, pale timber and handcrafted accents.
materials: washed oak; ivory cotton; rattan; limestone; muted blue
living: ivory deep slipcovered sofa; woven rattan armchair; oval pale-oak coffee table; oak media console; round oak four-seat table with four woven-back chairs; linen drum pendant
bed: washed-oak queen with linen headboard; white bedding and pale blue throw; oak nightstands with ceramic lamps
solarium: weathered teak outdoor sofa and armchair with ivory performance cushions; round teak four-seat dining set
implement: Keep curtains light and use a large woven rug to unify the shared room.
avoid: Avoid oversized sectionals that pinch the kitchen passage.

name: Warm Industrial
definition: Metal and robust timber gain comfort from leather, woven textiles and warm light.
materials: blackened steel; smoked oak; tan leather; charcoal wool; ribbed glass
living: tan leather track-arm sofa; charcoal upholstered steel-frame chair; smoked-oak rectangular steel-leg coffee table; black steel and oak media unit; compact oak dining table and four black metal chairs with tan pads; ribbed glass pendant
bed: smoked-oak queen with black steel details; charcoal and cream bedding; two black steel nightstands and adjustable lamps
solarium: black powder-coated outdoor metal seating with tan performance cushions; slatted black metal dining set
implement: Repeat the existing black glazing in slender furniture frames; balance hard surfaces with a wool rug.
avoid: Do not invent brick walls, exposed ducts or loft ceilings.

name: Warm Bauhaus
definition: Clear geometry, tubular frames and functional furniture balanced by tactile neutrals and controlled primary color.
materials: chrome tube; black leather; oak; wool; lacquer
living: cream rectilinear sofa on tubular chrome base; black leather cantilever lounge chair; round glass coffee table on chrome frame; low oak media cabinet; compact rectangular oak table and four chrome cantilever chairs; white globe light; one red-blue-yellow geometric artwork
bed: simple oak queen; cream bedding with mustard throw; black nightstands and spherical opal lamps
solarium: black tubular aluminum outdoor lounge chairs with cream mesh cushions; simple metal four-seat dining set
implement: Use primary colors in one artwork and a few cushions, keeping the large surfaces quiet.
avoid: Avoid filling the room with competing primary-color furniture.

name: Earthy Seventies Revival
definition: Rounded lounge furniture, walnut and warm spice colors, edited for a lighter contemporary condo.
materials: walnut; rust corduroy; amber glass; cream shag wool; smoked glass
living: rust corduroy low modular sofa; olive rounded swivel chair; smoked-glass rounded-square coffee table; walnut tambour media cabinet; round walnut table with four cream upholstered chairs; amber globe pendant
bed: walnut curved-headboard queen; cream bedding with rust and olive accents; walnut nightstands; amber globe lamps
solarium: teak low outdoor sofa and chair with rust weatherproof cushions; round teak dining set
implement: Choose one deep rust anchor and keep the cream walls and black kitchen intact.
avoid: Avoid sunken floors, conversation pits and oversized shag carpets.

name: Playful Postmodern
definition: Sculptural shapes and unexpected color pairings create a playful but usable interior.
materials: powder-coated metal; lavender wool; green lacquer; cream upholstery; terrazzo
living: lavender curved sofa; cream sculptural rounded chair; green lacquer cylinder coffee table; cream low media cabinet with round handles; round cream pedestal dining table and four terracotta curved chairs; yellow disc pendant
bed: cream arched queen headboard; lavender bedding accents; green cylinder side tables with small yellow lamps
solarium: green powder-coated outdoor sofa and chair with cream performance pads; round terracotta metal dining set
implement: Repeat circles in the table, lamp and artwork while using plain cream walls as breathing room.
avoid: Avoid novelty objects that obstruct circulation.

name: Colorful Scandinavian
definition: Nordic practicality with cheerful, carefully repeated blues, reds and butter yellow.
materials: birch; cotton; cobalt lacquer; striped wool; opal glass
living: dusty blue tailored birch-leg sofa; butter-yellow birch armchair; cobalt lacquer oval coffee table; birch TV cabinet; round birch table with four red spindle chairs; opal pendant; striped wool rug
bed: birch spindle queen; white bedding with blue stripe and yellow throw; birch nightstands; red small table lamps
solarium: light teak outdoor seating with blue striped performance cushions; red aluminum dining chairs and teak table
implement: Keep colored pieces small and repeat each accent twice for coherence.
avoid: Avoid changing every surface to a different saturated color.

name: Modern Cottage
definition: Small-scale florals and painted wood meet the simplicity of Nordic furniture.
materials: painted sage timber; linen; oak; small floral cotton; woven rush
living: cream linen skirted sofa; muted rose small-floral armchair; oval oak coffee table; sage painted TV cabinet; compact oak table with four sage spindle chairs; pleated cream pendant
bed: sage painted spindle queen; white quilt with muted rose floral accents; oak nightstands; pleated ceramic lamps
solarium: sage powder-coated outdoor seating with cream performance pads; teak four-seat dining table
implement: Let one floral textile carry the cottage character; keep the furniture compact.
avoid: Avoid excessive ruffles and decorative shelves along the narrow passage.

name: Edited English Country
definition: Traditional comfort and collected pattern with fewer, better-scaled pieces.
materials: walnut; moss velvet; tartan wool; aged brass; botanical cotton
living: moss velvet rolled-arm sofa; russet tartan armchair; oval walnut turned-leg coffee table; walnut media chest; rectangular walnut table and four rush-seat ladder-back chairs; pleated lamps; faded floral rug
bed: walnut gently curved queen headboard; ivory quilt; moss and russet plaid throw; walnut nightstands and brass pleated lamps
solarium: teak outdoor lounge set with moss cushions and small plaid weatherproof pillows; teak dining set
implement: Scale down the antique silhouettes and use one botanical grouping rather than crowded shelves.
avoid: Avoid heavy drapery across the condo's operable windows.

name: Light French Country
definition: Weathered timber, gentle curves and washed colors interpreted with a light hand.
materials: limed oak; linen; cane; aged iron; faded blue cotton
living: ivory linen sofa with subtle curved arms; pale-blue cane-back armchair; oval limed-oak coffee table; limed-oak media cabinet; round pedestal oak dining table and four cane-back chairs; linen pendant
bed: limed-oak curved queen headboard; white linen with faded blue quilt; two oak nightstands and cream urn lamps
solarium: weathered teak and woven outdoor seating with faded-blue performance cushions; round teak dining set
implement: Use graceful furniture shapes to soften the black glazing, while keeping ornament restrained.
avoid: Avoid ornate chandeliers and faux distressed finishes everywhere.

name: Shaker Contemporary
definition: Useful timber furniture, modest proportions and precise craftsmanship with contemporary comfort.
materials: maple; cherry; woven tape; cream cotton; black iron
living: cream upright sofa on cherry legs; cherry woven-seat armchair; rectangular cherry coffee table; cherry paneled media cabinet; compact cherry table with four ladder-back woven-seat chairs; simple cream dome pendant
bed: cherry spindle queen; cream quilt with sage throw; two modest cherry nightstands and cream table lamps
solarium: teak slat outdoor lounge furniture with sage pads; simple teak four-seat dining table
implement: Choose visible joinery and practical drawers; let proportion supply the decoration.
avoid: Avoid faux barn doors and rustic clutter.

name: Arts & Crafts Modern
definition: Honest oak joinery and nature-derived pattern balanced with clean upholstery.
materials: quarter-sawn oak; olive wool; copper; botanical textiles; ceramic
living: olive wool oak-frame sofa; cream botanical oak armchair; rectangular oak trestle coffee table; quarter-sawn oak TV cabinet; compact oak table with four slat-back chairs; copper shallow pendant
bed: oak slat-headboard queen; ivory bedding with olive botanical throw; oak nightstands and ceramic lamps
solarium: slatted teak outdoor seating with olive weatherproof cushions; teak rectangular dining set
implement: Repeat oak and one botanical motif; use slim versions of traditionally heavy furniture.
avoid: Avoid darkening all walls or copying historic rooms literally.

name: Forest Japandi
definition: Forest color and regional timber soften Japanese restraint with a few rounded organic forms.
materials: oak; moss wool; river stone; rice paper; linen
living: moss low tailored sofa; oak woven-seat lounge chair; rounded river-stone coffee table; low oak media cabinet; round oak four-seat table with four woven-seat chairs; paper oval pendant
bed: low oak queen; cream linen and moss throw; two oak cube nightstands with paper table lamps
solarium: low teak outdoor seating with moss weatherproof cushions; round teak dining set
implement: Combine only three strong cues: forest textiles, restrained timber furniture and one pebble-shaped table.
avoid: Avoid duplicating the original green PNW room with only different cushions.

name: Coastal Japandi
definition: Low, calm Japanese-influenced furniture with pale driftwood tones and soft sea-glass color.
materials: bleached oak; sea-glass linen; woven paper cord; chalk ceramic; cotton
living: sea-glass low sofa; pale oak paper-cord chair; oval bleached-oak coffee table; low bleached-oak TV cabinet; round pale-oak table with four paper-cord chairs; white paper lantern
bed: low pale-oak queen; ivory linen and sea-glass quilt; pale-oak nightstands and chalk ceramic lamps
solarium: pale teak outdoor seating with sea-glass performance cushions; round teak dining table
implement: Use pale green-blue in large textiles and keep artwork nearly monochrome.
avoid: Avoid nautical ropes, anchors or beach signs.

name: Japandi Deco
definition: Japanese restraint with a few geometric Deco accents and a richer material contrast.
materials: dark walnut; ivory linen; muted jade; bronze; pale stone
living: ivory low straight sofa; muted-jade rounded chair; pale oval stone coffee table with bronze base; dark walnut media cabinet; compact walnut table with four jade upholstered chairs; opal and bronze globe pendant; one restrained fan-pattern rug
bed: dark walnut low queen with gently curved jade headboard; ivory bedding; walnut nightstands and bronze opal lamps
solarium: dark teak outdoor seating with jade performance pads; teak dining table with bronze-tone metal chairs
implement: Limit Deco to one fan motif and bronze detailing so the Japanese restraint remains legible.
avoid: Avoid glossy black-and-gold glamour throughout.

name: Botanical Midcentury
definition: Classic tapered timber furniture surrounded by layered greens and leaf-shaped accents.
materials: walnut; fern velvet; cane; terracotta; botanical cotton
living: fern-green walnut-leg sofa; walnut cane lounge chair; kidney-shaped walnut coffee table; walnut tapered media console; compact walnut table with four molded timber chairs; cream saucer pendant; bold botanical art
bed: walnut spindle queen; ivory linen and fern quilt; walnut nightstands with terracotta lamps
solarium: teak outdoor lounge seating with fern performance cushions; teak dining set; generous grouped plants
implement: Use a small number of larger plants near glazing and repeat walnut in all main rooms.
avoid: Avoid blocking window handles and walkways with pots.

name: Belgian Mediterranean
definition: Relaxed Belgian linen and weathered wood warmed with Mediterranean clay and pale stone.
materials: flax linen; weathered oak; limestone; terracotta; woven rush
living: flax slipcovered sofa; weathered-oak rush armchair; oval limestone coffee table; weathered-oak media cabinet; rectangular oak table and four rush-seat chairs; oversized flax pendant
bed: weathered-oak queen with flax headboard; ivory linen and clay throw; oak nightstands and clay lamps
solarium: weathered teak outdoor sofa and chair with flax performance cushions; teak dining set and clay pots
implement: Make linen the dominant texture and reserve terracotta for lamps, throws and pots.
avoid: Avoid faux arches or replacing the fixed kitchen surfaces.

name: Parisian Midcentury
definition: Elegant artwork and a touch of brass meet sculptural midcentury walnut furniture.
materials: walnut; tobacco velvet; cream wool; brass; marble
living: cream curved sofa; tobacco velvet walnut lounge chair; oval marble coffee table on walnut legs; walnut media credenza; round walnut table with four cream upholstered chairs; brass globe pendant; large abstract art and a small antique frame
bed: cream curved queen headboard; ivory bedding and tobacco throw; walnut nightstands with brass dome lamps
solarium: teak outdoor seating with tobacco performance cushions; round teak dining set
implement: Pair one antique-looking artwork with clean walnut furniture; keep walls and ceiling architecture intact.
avoid: Avoid imitation Haussmann paneling that changes the condo shell.

name: Nordic Folk Modern
definition: Simple pale timber furniture animated by woven pattern and handmade color.
materials: pine; woven wool; indigo cotton; red painted wood; glazed ceramic
living: cream pine-leg sofa; indigo woven pine armchair; red painted oval coffee table; pine media cabinet; compact pine table with four spindle chairs; pleated paper pendant; restrained red-blue folk-pattern rug
bed: pine spindle queen; ivory quilt and indigo-red woven throw; pine nightstands and blue ceramic lamps
solarium: teak outdoor seating with indigo performance cushions and red patterned pillows; simple teak dining set
implement: Put the strongest woven pattern on one rug and keep upholstery mostly solid.
avoid: Avoid costume-like themed objects or mixing unrelated motifs.

name: Tropical Modern
definition: Airy teak, woven surfaces and broad-leaf greenery with architectural restraint.
materials: teak; cane; ivory linen; palm-green cotton; dark bronze
living: ivory teak-frame sofa; palm-green cane lounge chair; rectangular teak coffee table; teak cane-front TV cabinet; round teak table with four cane chairs; woven shallow pendant; large botanical artwork
bed: teak slatted queen; ivory bedding and palm-green throw; teak nightstands with woven-shade lamps
solarium: teak and rope outdoor lounge seating with palm-green performance cushions; round teak dining set; broad-leaf plants
implement: Let the solarium carry the lush planting while the living room stays open and ordered.
avoid: Avoid resort props, bamboo wall cladding or dense indoor plant walls.
